description: Create an Outbrain campaign, always PAUSED so it spends nothing: name (unique per marketer, up to 100 characters), cpc in the marketer's currency, objective Traffic (default) or Awareness, optional platforms and trackingSuffix (utm parameters). Pass budgetId for an existing budget OR budget {amount, type, pacing, dailyTarget, startDate, endDate} for a new one. Then add_outbrain_ads_promoted_links, and set_outbrain_ads_status after the user says yes. Read back. Free. Outbrain sets a minimum budget per account and currency (on ours, US$140 for a one-time CAMPAIGN budget and US$600 MONTHLY) and says so when one is too low; language is the two-letter code of the promoted pages (default en).

budget.description: a new budget for this campaign

cpc.description: cost per click, the marketer's currency

language.description: two-letter language of the promoted pages, default en

name: create_outbrain_ads_campaign
